text: Add the site to Google Search Console and verify ownership
Request indexing for the key pages (Home, Menu, Banquets, Contact); re-check the Page indexing report after a few days
Search site:yourdomain in Google and confirm the pages appear
Open the site and confirm Analytics shows the visit in Realtime
Claim and verify the Google Business Profile: same name, address and phone as the site, photos, menu link, hours, booking link
Link the social profiles (Instagram, YouTube, etc.) in Search Console settings and keep them in the site's sameAs data
Put a Google review link on the site, ask the first 20 guests for reviews, reply to every review
Create or verify listings with identical name, address, phone: Zomato, Swiggy, Justdial, TripAdvisor, Instagram bio link
Get 3 or more links from local food bloggers, event or wedding directories, partner venues
Set Google Alerts for the brand name and signature dishes
Publish the first posts (offer, event, menu update) on the site and the Business Profile
Run PageSpeed Insights and the Core Web Vitals report; fix anything red
